description: Telangana launches AI-driven emergency number 112, enhancing response times and integrating multiple services for improved citizen assistance.
body_lead: Telangana Police launched what it called an artificial intelligence-driven platform aimed at making emergency assistance faster and more coordinated across the state when citizens dial 112. The system was inaugurated by Director-General of Police C.V. Anand at the Telangana Integrated Command and Control Centre (TGiCCC) in Hyderabad, in the presence of senior police and government officials on Wednesday (August 5, 2026).
